title: Factoring a map of complexes through a K-flat complex up to homotopy
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma factors a map from a K-flat complex into an arbitrary complex through a K-flat complex, up to homotopy, with the factor map a quasi-isomorphism, and shows that flatness of the terms can be preserved. The proof is a pure exercise in the triangulated structure of the homotopy category: it completes the map to a distinguished triangle, replaces the cone by a K-flat complex with flat terms, uses the triangle axioms to build a new triangle whose third term is K-flat by the two-out-of-three property, maps it to the original triangle, and concludes that the new arrow is a quasi-isomorphism by two out of three. The improvement of the constructed complex to one with flat terms in each degree is obtained from the refinement lemma on distinguished triangles.
